name: Moussa Mara
role: Former Prime Minister of Mali (2014–2015); leader of Yéléma
notes: Former Prime Minister and chartered accountant; signatory of the September 2023 international open letter calling on G20 Heads of State to enact wealth taxes on extreme wealth.

name: Clément Dembélé
role: Presidential candidate (2018); president of the PCC
affiliation: Plateforme contre la corruption et le chômage (PCC)
party: Convergence patriotique pour le changement (CPM / Mali Ko)
notes: University professor and 2018 presidential candidate; explicitly proposed the introduction of an Impôt de Solidarité sur la Fortune (ISF) in Mali during his presidential campaign.
